summary: Walk-in wardrobe presented in clean, well-maintained decorative condition throughout. Features plush neutral carpeting, emulsioned walls with white painted woodwork, and bespoke fitted wardrobes with integrated LED rail lighting and wood-effect interior framing. Minor light surface marks noted to the door and wall finishes.

items.name: Ceiling
items.description: White emulsioned ceiling with recessed perimeter detail.

items.name: Walls
items.description: Plastered and emulsioned walls in white/off-white matt finish, with painted white profiled skirting boards throughout; recessed wardrobe returns finished in the same emulsion
defects: cluster of fine scuffs and rub marks mid level right hand side adjacent to the corner return
hairline scratch/pen-type mark mid level right hand side to corner arris
light rub marks mid to low level to walls beside door reveal
occasional shade marking mid level left hand side

items.name: Flooring
items.description: Grey cut-pile fitted carpet on foam underlay to the wardrobe area, meeting oak-effect engineered timber boarding at the doorway threshold with a metal threshold trim
defects: pile shading and vacuum/foot-traffic marks generally throughout
light flattening of pile to threshold and door swing area
slight darker shade marking to carpet at doorway threshold

items.name: Internal Door & Frame
items.description: White painted flush internal door on three brushed/bronzed butt hinges, with matching bronzed lever handle and thumbturn, set in painted white timber frame with moulded architrave; brushed metal striker plate to frame
defects: light rub/scuff marking low level to leading edge of door
small dark mark low level right hand side to door face above carpet
light rub marks to frame adjacent to striker plate mid level
paint blemish to architrave low level left hand side to exterior

items.name: Skirting Boards
items.description: White painted stepped-profile wooden skirting boards.

items.name: Doorway Threshold Strip
items.description: Brushed metal transition threshold strip between wood-effect flooring and carpet.

items.name: Built-In Wardrobes
items.description: Fitted double wardrobe units with white flush exterior doors, wood-grain interior framing, high-level storage shelves, and metal hanging rails.

items.name: Integrated Wardrobe Strip Lighting
items.description: Recessed linear LED under-shelf strip lights fitted above hanging rails inside wardrobes.

items.name: Light Switch
items.description: Single gang square dark bronze/black metal rocker light switch.

items.name: Clothes Hangers
items.description: Assorted slim plastic and wire clothes hangers in pink, white, and black.

items.name: Pillows & Bedding
items.description: White textured pillows / folded bedding stored on top shelf of left wardrobe bay.
